auditCoverage.description: Project placement only: audit coverage of the source project-audits/v1 artifact. Present only when at least one project failed (since 1.1.0).

failedProjectCount.description: Project placement only: projects whose adapter failed during audit. Present only when at least one project failed (since 1.1.0).

failedProjects.description: Supported projects whose adapter failed during audit, copied from the source artifact. Present only when at least one project failed (since 1.1.0).

reason.pattern: ^The [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63} adapter failed with (?:AggregateError|Error|EvalError|RangeError|ReferenceError|SyntaxError|TypeError|URIError)\.(?: (?:Permission was denied while reading the project\.|An input or output error occurred while reading the project\.|A directory was found where a file was expected\.|Too many symbolic links were encountered while reading the project\.|The process ran out of file handles while reading the project\.|A file name in the project is too long\.|The system ran out of file handles while reading the project\.|A file or directory disappeared or was not found during the audit\.|The system ran out of memory while reading the project\.|A file was found where a directory was expected\.|The operation was not permitted while reading the project\.))?$
